name: mission-control
description: Connects Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI to a self-hosted Mission Control instance (builderz-labs/mission-control) through its MCP server

mc_url.title: Mission Control URL
mc_url.description: Base URL of your Mission Control instance, e.g. https://mc.example.com

mc_api_key.title: Mission Control API key
mc_api_key.description: Agent-scoped key (mca_...) issued for this agent by the setup (npx @tvaliasek/mission-control-claude-plugin) or mc-enroll. Not the server's API_KEY: that is the admin key and would give this agent admin rights

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Unique name this Claude Code instance uses in Mission Control, e.g. build-box. Machines sharing a name share one agent and queue
